Requester meaning is a random complex reference-guided photographic concept testing the previously discussed selfie/self-portrait visual composition. The independently drawn carousel-repair scene shows a woman sharing a small, ridiculous victory: a broken painted wooden pin is held near the lens while the replaced red mane remains clamped on a white wooden carousel horse behind her. The intended experience is conversational closeness, material continuity and relieved amusement. The workshop, repair circumstances, hands, expression, clothes, blue hour and direct ultra-wide capture are authorial choices within open dimensions; the reference establishes visible face and hair guidance, not identity, age or biography. Saved sensual=1 supports subtle everyday presence; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no such treatment; creativity=1 gives restrained variation within the explicitly requested complex scene.

A layered self-portrait of the referenced woman, with the supplied image guiding her visible face and hair. Preserve her short dark bob, separated wispy fringe and natural facial proportions. She is in a narrow carousel restoration bay at blue hour, and she takes her own photograph while showing the small failure that has just been repaired. A white wooden carousel horse stands on a padded workbench behind her right shoulder. Its red carved mane panel has been returned to its place along the neck; a small brass clamp bridges the newly joined seam. Her spare right hand holds a hand-length broken wooden joining pin toward the camera, its red paint stripe and pale splintered end connecting visually to that repaired red mane. The pin is large enough to recognize as painted broken wood. Fine pale wood dust on the bench, a used sanding block and a warm test bulb beside the horse make the ongoing restoration tangible. Her face sits near the center of the frame, and her eyes meet the lens with a tired, pleased half-smile, one corner of the mouth rising as if quietly sharing the repair's ridiculous little victory. A faint dusty flush, a loose strand beside her cheek and the soft fall of an indigo linen work shirt give her an approachable everyday presence. The open shirt collar and rolled sleeves belong to the working moment. Her right elbow remains bent close to her torso; her thumb and index finger pinch the intact end of the broken pin, while her other fingers curl naturally behind it. The nearest right hand occupies the lower-right foreground, clear of her face and of the visible clamp behind her. This is the direct image from the ultra-wide camera of a smartphone held in her extended left hand, slightly above eye level and pointed back toward her. Her left shoulder, upper arm and forearm make one continuous diagonal toward the lower-left edge, where her camera-holding hand continues just beyond the frame. The short camera distance makes the near right hand and wooden pin loom larger than her centered face; the workbench and horse recede behind them. Keep the face's central proportions natural while letting the close edge hand and diverging shed lines show the broad projection. Show the scene down to her waist, with her stance supported on the workshop floor. Cool evening light enters through the open loading door behind her and warm practical light grazes the red mane, worn paint and fine grain of the broken wood. Crisp, tactile smartphone photography retains readable depth from the fingers to the clamp; the dominant connection is her expression, the broken pin and the repaired horse.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.

levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.

choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.
